scenario: Report is structured per-rule with feature-level breakdowns per LCMP.3.1. A rule with a call action generates rule-level call-analysis entries. Pin: a call in a rule compiles cleanly, exercising the per-rule analysis path.
rules_ds:
schema SensorReadReply scope ttl 1_h:
    corr: String
    status: Int

service sensor.read:
    kwarg entity_id: String
    response SensorReadReply

schema Trig scope logical:
    entity_id: String key

rule with_call:
    Trig t
->
    call sensor.read entity_id: t.entity_id cooldown: 30_s
        on response.status == 200:
            log info "ok"
        timeout 10_s:
            log info "timeout"
        error:
            log info "error"
